title: Northbeam TechWorks Billing Office: The Surcharge Entry a Membership Relief Takes In
content:
Where a surcharge stands booked on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job for the day the crew was last sent out, that surcharge is taken into the relief; where a surcharge stands booked on the job only for the day the job was held for parts, that earlier surcharge is taken into the relief. Where neither situation holds, no part of any surcharge is taken into the relief.

## What is read

Whether any surcharge entry stands on the job at all, and the attendance day each such entry carries, are read from the job's service history. The day the crew was last sent out and the day the job was held for parts are read from the job itself.

## The three readings

| Surcharge entries standing on the job | The surcharge figure |
| --- | --- |
| one or more, with an amount booked for the day the crew was last sent out | that surcharge |
| one or more, none for that day but one for the day the job was held for parts | that earlier surcharge |
| none | no part of any surcharge |

The first situation takes precedence: where a surcharge for the day the crew was last sent out stands on the job, that is the figure, whatever earlier surcharge entries also stand.

## Illustrations on hypothetical jobs

*The amounts below are chosen for the illustration and are not figures of any job on file.*

**No surcharge entry at all.** Where no surcharge entry stands on a hypothetical job, no part of any surcharge is taken into the relief and the surcharge figure is nothing.

**A surcharge for the hold day only.** A hypothetical job was held for parts on one day and the crew was last sent out on a later day. A surcharge of 27.60 USD stands booked for the day the job was held for parts and none for the day the crew was last sent out. That earlier surcharge is taken, and 27.60 USD is the surcharge figure.

**A surcharge for the day the crew was last sent out.** The same job also carries a surcharge of 52.80 USD booked for that later day. The first situation now governs and 52.80 USD is the surcharge figure.
